name: diaspora-mcp
description: Kenya diaspora services via MCP — immigration, dual citizenship, diaspora taxes, homeland investment, community

tools.name: dual_citizenship_guide
tools.description: Explain Kenyan dual citizenship for someone abroad: eligibility, how to keep or regain Kenyan citizenship, the Kenyan passport, diaspora registration and voting from abroad, with embassy contacts. Use when a Kenyan abroad asks whether they can hold two nationalities. current_citizenship is echoed back; the guidance is general. Returns the source label, current_citizenship, the dual-citizenship rules, passport and registration steps and embassy contacts. A static summary of the Citizenship and Immigration Act 2011 labelled DEMO and not legal advice: verify fees and forms with the embassy or the Department of Immigration. Read-only; no side effects.

tools.name: diaspora_tax_guide
tools.description: Summarise the tax position of a Kenyan living abroad in a country in the table (such as the USA, UK or Canada): Kenyan tax on Kenya income, the residence country's rules and double-taxation points. Use when someone asks what tax they owe at home or abroad. residence_country is matched case-insensitively; an unrecognised country returns an error listing the supported ones. Returns the source label, the country, the tax guidance, a key principle, the KRA portal and a disclaimer. Static summary labelled DEMO and NOT tax advice: consult a cross-border tax accountant. Read-only; no side effects.

tools.name: kenya_homeland_investment
tools.description: Investment options at home for a budget in US dollars: M-Akiba bonds, money market funds, NSE shares and a REIT, with minimums, indicative returns and risk. Use when a diaspora investor asks where to put a given amount. Every option is returned; budget_usd only changes the closing recommendation text. Returns the source label, budget_usd, the options, a platform recommendation and a pointer to faida-mcp. Indicative returns labelled DEMO and not investment advice. Read-only; no side effects.

tools.name: diaspora_verification
tools.description: Guidance on authenticating documents for use in Kenya from abroad (birth certificate, marriage certificate, academic and other documents): who certifies them and the apostille route, since Kenya is party to the Hague Apostille Convention. Use when someone needs a foreign or Kenyan document accepted. document_type selects an entry; if none match, a general instruction to contact the nearest Kenyan embassy is returned; with no argument all documents are listed. Returns the source label, the guidance, the apostille note and the embassy finder. Labelled DEMO: confirm requirements with the receiving authority. Read-only; no side effects.

tools.name: diaspora_community_guide
tools.description: Kenyan diaspora organisations by country, with their focus, plus investment facilitation, voter registration and remittance pointers. Use when someone abroad wants to find community or professional groups. country is matched case-insensitively; an unrecognised country returns an error listing the supported countries. Returns the source label, the country, the organisations, the Kenya Investment Authority contact, voter registration and a remittance note citing the Central Bank of Kenya's USD 4.94 billion for 2024. A short sample directory labelled DEMO: verify each organisation. Read-only; no side effects.

tools.name: immigration_status_guide
tools.description: General notes on immigration statuses in the USA, UK and Canada (for example green card holder or student) and what each allows. Use when a Kenyan abroad asks what a status permits or where to get legal help. country selects the guide; status matches an entry by text and, if none match, a general consult-an-attorney note is returned; with no status all statuses are listed. Returns the source label, the country, the guidance and a disclaimer. Static summary labelled DEMO and NOT immigration legal advice: rules change, so consult a licensed immigration attorney. Read-only; no side effects.
